title: The Weather of Room 214
author: Tamsin Amberdale
blurb: Wendell Montrose, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when a childhood home goes up for auction, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around before the mother's memory goes entirely.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
